gp.heading: Gross profit
gp.text:
Gross profit margin increased to 22.8% during the three months ended September 30, 2026 from 22.7% during the three months ended September 30, 2025. Material factors affecting this increase were a 270 basis point increase due to favorable mix, a 150 basis point increase due to operating efficiencies, and a 70 basis point increase due to higher sales, partially offset by a 320 basis point decline from higher commodity and wage inflation, as well as a 210 basis point decline from an inventory write off associated with the exit of a business.

Gross profit margin decreased to 22.3% during the nine months ended September 30, 2026 from 22.5% during the nine months ended September 30, 2025. Material factors affecting this decrease were a 250 basis point decline from higher commodity and wage inflation and a 70 basis point decline from an inventory write off associated with the exit of a business, partially offset by a 240 basis point increase due to operating efficiencies.

rd.heading: Research and development expense
rd.text:
Research and development expense decreased to $24 million during the three months ended September 30, 2026 from $30 million during the three months ended September 30, 2025. The material factor affecting this decrease was savings associated with 2025 restructuring actions.

Research and development expense decreased to $67 million during the nine months ended September 30, 2026 from $81 million during the nine months ended September 30, 2025. The material factor affecting this decrease was savings associated with 2025 restructuring actions.

nonop.heading: Interest expense (income) - net
nonop.text:
Interest expense (income) - net went to expense of $1 million during the three months ended September 30, 2026 from $0 million of expense during the three months ended September 30, 2025. The material factor driving this change was changes in foreign currency exchange rates.

Interest expense (income) - net went to expense of $2 million during the nine months ended September 30, 2026 from $7 million of income during the nine months ended September 30, 2025. The material factor driving this change was changes in foreign currency exchange rates.

pretax.text: SpinCo has defined adjusted EBITDA as net income before interest, income taxes, depreciation, amortization, restructuring program charges, and acquisition integration and divestiture charges.

tax.text: During the three months ended September 30, 2026, income tax expense was $32 million (an effective tax rate of 37.2%) compared to income tax expense of $4 million during the three months ended September 30, 2025 (an effective tax rate of 15.4%). The increase in the effective tax rate in the third quarter of 2026 was primarily due to an increase in the amount of unrecognized income tax benefits.

net.text: SpinCo has defined adjusted EBITDA as net income before interest, income taxes, depreciation, amortization, restructuring program charges, and acquisition integration and divestiture charges.

ocf.text: Net cash provided by operating activities increased by $218 million during the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to the nine months ended September 30, 2025. The material factor affecting this increase was favorable changes in working capital. Changes in working capital resulted in a cash inflow of $84 million during the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to a cash outflow of $166 million during the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

capex.heading: Capital Expenditures
capex.text: Capital expenditures were $64 million and $63 million during the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025, respectively.

net sales.heading: Net sales
net sales.text:
Organic sales increased 8% during the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025 due to strength in the North American and European regions.

Organic sales were flat during the nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to the nine months ended September 30, 2025 due to strength in the North American and European regions, offset by weakness in the Asia Pacific region.

intro.text: The Mobility Business is a global mobility and engineered-systems partner serving commercial vehicle, light vehicle, and aftermarket customers worldwide. The Company designs and manufactures mission-critical powertrain, drivetrain, engine, air management, electrical and electronic components and systems that safely, efficiently, and reliably create, manage, and deliver mechanical and electrical power across vehicles. The Company operates across the propulsion spectrum, from internal combustion, to hybrid, to fully electric, to support original equipment manufacturer customers with a portfolio of differentiated solutions.
